text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black powered through the mud with 
tremendous force. Stunned silence fell 
over the crowd, and then—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A massive explosion of burning, passionate 
cheers. This run enchants the fans once 
more, and witnessing the spectacle 
inspires Satono Diamond to fire herself 
up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next goal is the global festival, the 
"Japan Cup." They vow to hype up Tokyo 
Racecourse alongside top contenders.
